title: Prosecution eyes records of VP-linked group over China donations
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial is considering seeking financial records involving Tapang at Malasakit Alliance for the Philippines…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial is considering seeking financial records involving Tapang at Malasakit Alliance for the Philippines after Senator-Judge Bam Aquino raised possible donations from China on Tuesday. Aquino asked House prosecution counsel Mae Divinagracia whether prosecutors would move to obtain the group’s records after the issue surfaced during the proceedings. “We are considering it, Your Honor,” Divinagracia replied.
